name: Recall (Windows)
short_description: An opt-in Windows feature on Copilot+ PCs that saves encrypted snapshots of the screen locally and lets users search their past activity in natural language.

evidence.quote: Recall is the headline example, and it builds a searchable timeline of what you've seen on your screen.
Recall zijn automatische, lokale screenshots op je apparaat.
Recall to automatyczne, lokalne zrzuty ekranu urządzenia.
Recall è un accumulatore automatico di screenshot.
Recall, acumulador automático de captura de tela.
